description: A ranked shortlist for siting or scheduling a large electricity load under a lens. Returns the top markets with score, lens_score (0-100), tier and a one-line why. It ranks; it does not certify that a site can connect. Responses from API schema 1.1 onward also carry figures.{field} = {value, unit, as_of (ISO date or month), source, method, confidence, stable_id, report_url}: when present, quote the unit and as_of from it, and a null value there carries figures.{field}.absence -- insufficient_evidence (not enough evidence), structurally_unavailable (does not exist there, e.g. no wholesale market), not_collected (exists, not held) or withheld (paid) -- with reason_text; report which one. Older responses have no figures object: take the unit from the field name or field_provenance and the date from as_of. Either way, never report an absent value as zero; say it is not held.

lens.description: Weighting lens. 'default' is carbon-light; 'carbon' favours clean grids, 'cost' cheap delivered power, 'momentum' proven build-out.

min_tier.description: Only markets at this tier or better (1=best, 5=worst).

name: pgiq_best
